# Installation and Debugging
Prerequisites: Node.js v24 or higher (older might work) installed. Example Windows guide link. Need pnpm. Need database connection as described in Database. If docker need running docker.
Configuration: .env or .env.dev, local dev use .env.dev added to gitignore, overrides default config. Starting point env.dev.sample. Optionally change topic.json. Optionally swagger-descprition.md typo? It says swagger-descprition.md (typo) to be shown on Swagger. If don't create own, example swagger description markdown file will be used.
Database: accessible database connection. PostgreSQL v15 with PostGIS. Sample data in sql\data dump must be imported. Three approaches:
- set up own database, follow tutorials; ensure accessible by host; add needed parameters to postgresql.conf and pg_hba.conf; create extension postgis; optional postgis_raster; use psql/pg_restore/pgadmin to import test data dump.
- check installation guide link for PostgreSQL without admin rights.
- use docker environment automatically.
Add new database support link.
Installation: pnpm install.
Running app: pnpm run start, start:dev watch mode, start:prod compile production (does NOT start service).
Browser: navigate to localhost:3000/api SwaggerUI and /api-json.
Test: unit/e2e/coverage commands.
Docker: possible with Docker/Podman. docker-compose.yml development file creates instance of analysis-interface, PostgreSQL with PostGIS and example data. Data imported from dump sql/data and bounding box coords. pgAdmin4 included. Two Dockerfiles dev/prod. compose files run containers based on Dockerfiles. File structure.
Docker Prerequisite: running docker service. Docker Desktop link. Default database connection set in docker-compose-(prod).yml environment properties. compose uses specific network, service names, ports exposed.
Run: docker compose up. Three containers created: geospatialanalyzer-postgres-dev|prod, geospatialanalyzer-app-dev|prod, geospatialanalyzer-pgadmin-dev. Changes in src synced.
Dev/Prod container: commands.
Troubleshooting: if update package.json, docker files etc, do docker compose down -v up --build, warns deletes manually added DB data.
Common Errors: bad interpreter check line endings LF; TypeORM connection retry ensure edited .env files synchronized but read at start, need restart container with docker compose up.
PgAdmin4: navigate to localhost:5050. Add local docker database: steps with host db, port, maintenance db, username postgres, password geobakery.
